notes.title: Update on Nov 17th
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The Shadow of Kingdoms team is happy to announce our Limited Weekly Events for the week of 11/17-11/23.

Charge Ranking Bonus – Thank you very much for supporting Shadow of Kingdoms. Please take these gifts as token of our appreciation. Victory and honor be upon you and your castle!

Diamond Rebate – Spend your precious diamonds to redeem your rebate diamonds back to you. The more diamonds you use, the more diamonds shall return to be used again.

Sweep Gifts – Are you ready to sweep the dungeon? You will get reward if you complete the dungeon “The Wailing Cave” for 10 times. Good Luck!

And also the rule of mastery has been changed: there is a 100% chance to receive a new mastery.

See you again on the battlefields!

Sincerely,
Shadow of Kingdoms Team

notes.title: Update at 4 am EST 11/10
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The Shadow of Kingdoms team is happy to announce our Limited Weekly Events for the week of 11/10-11/16.

Purchase Reward – Thank you very much for supporting Shadow of Kingdoms. The more diamonds you purchase the more you will get. You will receive 20% diamonds more by purchasing more than 100 diamonds. The reward diamonds will be sent via mail within 2 days after ending of the event.

Lucky Day – Congratulations, today is your lucky day! Receive 120% drops for all dungeons and missions you and your friends complete.

Upgrade Gifts – Is your hero ready to take his/her skills to the next level? Upgrade the quality of your hero to power up and receive special gifts in the process.

Rising Star Gifts – Tired of taking tiny armies to the battlefield? It’s time to raise the star level of your hero to increase unit limit and receive special gifts as well.

See you again on the battlefields!

Sincerely,
Shadow of Kingdoms Team
